about.title: About
about.lead: Most delivery problems start at the handoffs: unclear ownership, slow decisions, and manual work that keeps coming back. I make those workflows visible, owned, and easier to run.
about.body1: At HomeTeam Network, I launched remote production in six weeks and built the operating team from zero. At Interlaced, I led onboarding automation that provisions Google Workspace accounts, retries failures, and escalates exceptions. At Sky Mavis, I automated request routing across Legal, Growth, Operations, and Finance.
about.body2: My engineering and QA background helps me scope work and make trade-offs with developers. I use AI to triage tickets, draft responses, summarize data, and accelerate product work from a clear specification.
